research_history_boundary.claim_scope: candidate-level frozen test, not a globally pristine market holdout

mechanism.name: intrinsic-volume latent-impact relay
mechanism.economic_object: the first daily crossing of a fixed notional target derived only from prior complete UTC days; strong cumulative aggressive flow that has moved price in the same direction but with below-tail-normalized impact is treated as buffered inventory pressure whose price adjustment is delayed
new_geometry: forward accumulation from a fixed UTC-day origin
one first-passage event per UTC day
equalized prior-volume target rather than a backward fixed-time window
direction from signed flow and admission from causal impact under-response
explicitly_not: the backward rolling volume-clock jump gate
an LLM-generated side, entry, exit, or threshold

source_contract.missing_bar_policy: fail closed; no interpolation or forward fill

causal_feature_contract.daily_expected_volume: median total quote_asset_volume of the previous 28 complete UTC days; current day excluded; at least 21 complete days required
causal_feature_contract.anchor: first completed five-minute bar of the UTC day whose cumulative quote volume reaches the intrinsic target; reject anchors after 17:55 UTC
causal_feature_contract.cumulative_flow: sum(2*taker_buy_quote-quote_asset_volume) from UTC-day start through the anchor divided by cumulative quote volume over the same bars
causal_feature_contract.event_reference: the previous 180 eligible daily anchors, excluding current; at least 90 required; NumPy linear quantiles without clipping or winsorization
causal_feature_contract.flow_gate: abs(cumulative_flow) >= prior-event q60 absolute cumulative flow
causal_feature_contract.under_response_gate: impact_ratio <= prior-event q70 impact ratio among finite aligned anchors
causal_feature_contract.rolling_extrema: rolling 2,016 completed bars including the anchor; range_position = (anchor_close-low)/(high-low); zero-width ranges are ineligible
causal_feature_contract.headroom_gate: LONG requires range_position <= 0.80; SHORT requires range_position >= 0.20
causal_feature_contract.side: LONG when cumulative_flow>0; SHORT when cumulative_flow<0

execution_contract.decision: after the intrinsic-volume anchor bar closes
execution_contract.exit: scheduled open exactly 72 five-minute bars after entry
execution_contract.cagr: full declared calendar including warmup and idle cash
execution_contract.strict_mdd: global/pre-entry HWM with entry cost, exact funding, every held-bar favorable-then-adverse path, virtual adverse exit cost, and actual exit

source_support_gate.failure_action: reject without calculating a post-entry return

source_only_controls.exact_side_flip: same primary timestamps with opposite side
source_only_controls.flow_only: drop alignment, impact, and rolling-extrema headroom gates
source_only_controls.no_under_response: retain flow, alignment, and headroom; drop impact gate
source_only_controls.no_headroom: retain flow, alignment, and impact; drop range-position gate
source_only_controls.fixed_noon: replace first-passage anchor with completed 11:55 UTC bar while retaining strictly-prior daily/event references and all signal gates
source_only_controls.stale_previous_anchor_side: primary clock with the immediately preceding eligible anchor flow side
source_only_controls.deterministic_random_side: primary clock with NumPy default_rng seed from SHA256('IVLIR-72|side')

strict_sequence.phase_2: hash-freeze strict evaluator before any post-entry outcome
strict_sequence.phase_4: open selection 2023 only if train passes

llm_boundary.reason: prior Gemma SFT/DPO event selectors repeatedly learned class priors; the base event must first demonstrate causal economic edge
